onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: Handy Tool needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

modelSettings.title: {{model}} Settings
modelSettings.noSettingsNeeded: This model works automatically with no configuration needed.

autoDetectLanguage.description: This model detects the spoken language automatically and can't be locked to a specific language. To force a language, switch to a Whisper, SenseVoice, FLM, or API model.

shortcut.title: Handy Tool Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_ptt.name: Push-to-Talk Shortcut
transcribe_ptt.description: Hold to record, release to stop.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

type_text.name: Type Text Shortcut
type_text.description: Types the Keyboard Typer text into the focused window. Press again to cancel.

transcribe_and_submit.name: Transcribe & Submit Shortcut
transcribe_and_submit.description: Finish recording, paste the transcription, then press the submit key. Works even if recording was started with another shortcut.

anchor_set.name: Set Anchor
anchor_set.description: Anchors the currently focused text field as the delivery target for the next transcription.

anchor_jump.name: Jump to Anchor
anchor_jump.description: Brings the anchored window and field into focus without pasting anything.

jump_set_slot_1.name: Set Jump Slot 1
jump_set_slot_1.description: Memorizes the focused field as jump slot 1.

jump_set_slot_2.name: Set Jump Slot 2
jump_set_slot_2.description: Memorizes the focused field as jump slot 2.

jump_set_slot_3.name: Set Jump Slot 3
jump_set_slot_3.description: Memorizes the focused field as jump slot 3.

jump_set_slot_4.name: Set Jump Slot 4
jump_set_slot_4.description: Memorizes the focused field as jump slot 4.

jump_slot_1.name: Jump to Slot 1
jump_slot_1.description: Brings jump slot 1's window and field into focus.

jump_slot_2.name: Jump to Slot 2
jump_slot_2.description: Brings jump slot 2's window and field into focus.

jump_slot_3.name: Jump to Slot 3
jump_slot_3.description: Brings jump slot 3's window and field into focus.

jump_slot_4.name: Jump to Slot 4
jump_slot_4.description: Brings jump slot 4's window and field into focus.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value
errors.registrationFailed: Some shortcuts could not be registered and are inactive: {{bindings}}. Another app may already be using them — pick a different combination in Settings.

anchor.title: Anchor & Deliver
anchor.deliveryFailed: Anchored delivery failed: {{reason}}. Your text is on the clipboard and the anchor was kept.

status.title: Current anchor
status.description: The next transcription is delivered into the anchored field, then the anchor is cleared (unless kept). Click a text field and press Set Anchor to arm it.

keep.label: Keep anchor after delivery
keep.description: Leave the anchor armed after a successful delivery instead of clearing it, for repeated dictation into the same field.

returnFocus.label: Return focus after delivery
returnFocus.description: Switch back to the window you were using once the text has been delivered.

idle.title: Jump slot action when idle
idle.description: What this shortcut additionally does with the selected jump slot when pressed while nothing is being transcribed. Jump navigates to the slot's field immediately.

stop.title: Jump slot action when transcribing
stop.description: What this shortcut additionally does with the selected jump slot when pressed while a transcription is in progress (the finishing press). Jump delivers the transcription into the slot's field.

pasteMethod.title: Paste method
pasteMethod.description: How the transcription is pasted for the Transcribe & Submit shortcut.

submitKey.title: Submit key
submitKey.description: The key pressed after pasting to submit (e.g. send a message or run a command).

idleBehavior.title: When no recording is active
idleBehavior.description: What this shortcut does if you press it when nothing is being recorded yet. Finishing a recording with this shortcut always uses the paste method and submit key configured here.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Keep your existing clipboard after pasting, or leave the transcription on the clipboard.

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.
language.descriptionUnsupported: Parakeet model automatically detects the language. No manual selection is needed.

pushToTalk.label: Push To Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, release to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

jumper.windowsOnly: The Jumper is available on Windows only.

slot.title: Static slot {{index}}
slot.description: Static slots are never cleared automatically — set one on a field you keep returning to and jump back any time. A slot remembers the window and field, not a browser tab or cursor position, and lasts until that window closes or Handy restarts.

output.label: Track last output location
output.description: After each normal transcription is pasted, remember that field in the hot slot so Jump to Anchor returns you there.

submit.label: Track last output location
submit.description: After each Transcribe & Submit delivery, remember that field in the hot slot so Jump to Anchor returns you there.

enabled.label: Watch folders
enabled.description: Transcribe new audio files (.wav, .ogg, .opus) that appear in the watched folders into a .txt next to each file, using the current model, language, and translate settings. Files already in a folder when watching starts are left alone.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: How folder batch work shares the engine with live dictation. Live dictation first: batch pauses the moment you start recording and resumes afterwards (nothing is lost — it pauses between segments). Folder batch first: batch keeps working; live text may arrive slightly later. First come, first served: the file in progress finishes, then live work runs before the next file.

status.title: Status
status.description: What the Translator is doing right now. Finished transcripts are written next to the audio file with the same name and a .txt extension.

paused.processing: paused while a recording is finishing

folders.title: Watched folders
folders.emptyDescription: Add a folder to start watching it for new recordings.
folders.addDescription: New audio files that appear in the folder are queued for transcription. The recordings folder Handy already uses as a queue is preconfigured.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

tokenCountProviders.hint: Providers for the Token Count page. Tip: the model only selects the tokenizer — pick the smallest model of the family you care about (e.g. qwen3:0.6b counts the same as qwen3:8b but loads in a fraction of the time). Anthropic and Gemini counting endpoints are free; local servers are queried with a 1-token probe.
tokenCountProviders.refreshModels: Load model list from the endpoint

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

crashResilientRecording.label: Crash-Safe Recording
crashResilientRecording.description: Record to compact Opus files in ~10-minute chunks as you speak, so audio survives a crash and long recordings transcribe as they go. If Handy Tool crashes mid-recording, the audio is recovered into your history on the next launch. Turn off to keep everything in memory until you stop.

openRecordingsFolder.label: Recordings Folder
openRecordingsFolder.description: Open the folder where recordings and recovered audio are stored.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Handy Tool when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Handy Tool icon in the system tray.

overlay.title: Overlay Position
overlay.description: Display visual feedback overlay during recording and transcription. On Linux 'None' is recommended.

pasteMethodPtt.title: Paste Method (PTT)
pasteMethodPtt.description: Choose how text is inserted when using Push-to-Talk mode.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardRestoreDelay.title: Clipboard restore delay
clipboardRestoreDelay.description: Extra wait before your original clipboard is restored after pasting. Remote sessions (Citrix, RDP) fetch clipboard data after the paste keystroke arrives — if pastes in a remote session insert your old clipboard instead of the transcription, increase this.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.
translateToEnglish.descriptionUnsupported: Translation is not supported by the {{model}} model.
translateToEnglish.unsupported: Not available for the selected transcription model.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time. 'Never' keeps the model loaded so recording starts instantly.

transcriptionMode.title: Transcription Mode
transcriptionMode.description: Live: use progressive text instantly on stop. Post-Recording: re-transcribe the full audio for best accuracy.

transcriptionModePtt.title: Transcription Mode (PTT)
transcriptionModePtt.description: Live: instant text on stop. Post-Recording: re-transcribe full audio for best accuracy.

url.title: API URL
url.description: Base URL including version prefix (e.g. /v1) for the OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text API.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name to send in the request.

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Add words that are often misheard or misspelled during transcription. The system will automatically correct similar-sounding words to match your list.

mcp.description: Expose a local server so Claude (app & Code) and the `handy` CLI can drive Handy Tool — run model tests, count tokens, type text, read history, and configure providers. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only and requires the token below.
mcp.claudeApp: Claude app (HTTP) — add a custom MCP server with this URL:
mcp.cliHint: Installs the `handy` CLI onto your PATH so you can run `handy model-test`, `handy token-count`, etc. from any terminal.

costReport.title: Transcription cost report
costReport.description: Per-recording cost (real USD from OpenRouter) and length, summarized by week, month, and year. Download the full report — every recording plus the summaries — as a CSV.

llmProviders.hint: Configure the LLM providers used for token counting, post-processing, and model testing. Each has a stable id (#1, #2, …) — post-processing and the model tester reference a provider by that id, so anything you change here applies everywhere.
llmProviders.persistPriceHint: Keep this price even when the model changes (don't auto-fill from OpenRouter)

provider.title: OpenRouter provider
provider.description: Which registered OpenRouter provider supplies the API key for transcription. Add one under the Providers tab.
provider.none: No OpenRouter provider with an API key. Add/enable one under Advanced → Providers first, then pick it here.

model.title: Transcription model
model.description: OpenRouter speech-to-text model. The picker lists STT models (Whisper, GPT-4o-transcribe, Chirp, …); defaults to openai/whisper-large-v3 if left blank. For the Chat route use an audio-capable model (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash).

route.title: Endpoint
route.description: Transcription: the dedicated /audio/transcriptions STT endpoint. Chat: a multimodal LLM via chat completions with audio input.

format.title: Audio format
format.description: Format sent to OpenRouter. Opus is ~10x smaller (light on bandwidth) but support varies by model; WAV is the most compatible.

api.title: API (OpenAI Compatible)

appleIntelligence.title: Apple Intelligence
appleIntelligence.description: Runs fully on-device. No API key or network access is required.
appleIntelligence.requirements: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later. Apple Intelligence must be enabled in System Settings.
appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL including version prefix (e.g. /v1). Only editable for the Custom provider.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionApple: Provide an optional numeric token limit or keep the default on-device preset.
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Lower is more deterministic and firm (0 = most literal); higher is more creative.

api.registryNote: The provider's API key, model, and base URL are configured in Advanced → Registered LLM Providers.

disableThinking.label: Disable Thinking
disableThinking.description: Send think: false to the model. Speeds up responses but may reduce instruction-following for thinking models (e.g. Qwen3).

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

currentAudio.title: Current Audio
currentAudio.idle: Start recording to see live transcription

history.title: History

search.regexActive: Query is being treated as a regular expression

history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay
pasteDelay.description: Delay before sending paste keystroke (in milliseconds). Increase if wrong text is being pasted.

backup.description: Export your Handy Tool data as a compressed archive. Downloaded models and large uncompressed audio (WAV/FLAC) are always excluded.
backup.configHint: Settings and the transcription history database (timestamps, text, cost, duration) — no audio files. Small.
backup.fullHint: Everything above plus your compressed recordings (.opus/.ogg). Excludes models and large WAV/FLAC files.
backup.restoreHint: Pick a Handy Tool backup archive (.tar.gz) and choose what to bring back. Only known Handy Tool files are restored — nothing else in the archive is touched.
backup.restartHint: Restart Handy Tool to load the restored settings/history (until then the running app may overwrite them).

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Handy Tool stores its data

supportDevelopment.title: Support Development
supportDevelopment.description: Help us continue building Handy Tool

handy.title: Handy
handy.description: The original open-source speech-to-text app this project is built on
handy.details: Handy Tool is a fork of Handy, created by CJ Pais (github.com/cjpais/Handy, handy.computer). It was taken over at upstream v0.8.1 (March 2026) and has been further developed independently by Patrick R. Huge thanks to CJ and the Handy contributors for the foundation this project stands on.

whisper.title: Whisper.cpp
whisper.description: High-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model
whisper.details: Handy Tool uses Whisper.cpp for fast, local speech-to-text processing. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

modelPicker.noMatches: No matching models — type to use a custom id

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Handy Tool needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Handy Tool interface

flm.notInstalled: FLM is not installed. Install FastFlowLM to use NPU-accelerated models.

tokenCount.title: Token Count
tokenCount.placeholder: Paste text here to count tokens...
tokenCount.countAllTitle: Count with every enabled provider one at a time — right when slots share one local service that must load/unload each model
tokenCount.countAllParallelTitle: Query every enabled provider at the same time — fastest when services are independent
tokenCount.chipDisabled: Not configured — enable it in Advanced > Token Count Providers

keyboardTyper.title: Keyboard Typer
keyboardTyper.description: Types text into any application via simulated keystrokes — for remote sessions and apps where pasting is blocked. The text is kept in memory only and is never saved to disk.

shortcut.label: Shortcut:
shortcut.hint: (change it in Advanced settings; press it again to cancel)

status.idle: Click Go, then focus the target window — or use the shortcut directly in the target app.

modelTesting.description: Run one prompt across multiple registered models and compare cost, speed, and output. Optionally add a judge panel that reviews all answers with a second prompt.
modelTesting.noProviders: No chat-capable providers configured. Add one in Advanced → Registered LLM Providers.
modelTesting.mainPromptPlaceholder: The prompt sent to every selected model…
modelTesting.judgePromptPlaceholder: Instructions for the judge panel. It receives the original input plus every model's answer (XML-tagged).

image.label: Image (optional, for vision models)
image.drop: Click or drag an image here to attach

modelTesting.saveDisabled: Use “Save as…” first to choose a location
